# read RNA
with gzip.open('multiome.match.atac.rna.q1.rna.tsv.gz','rt') as f:
    header=f.readline().rstrip().split('\\t')[1:]
    genes=[]; data=[]
    for line in f:
        p=line.rstrip().split('\\t')
        genes.append(p[0]); data.append(list(map(float,p[1:9])))
X=pd.DataFrame(data,index=genes,columns=header)
print(X.shape)
# log? TPM, identify specificity ratio col / mean other
Xp=X+0.1
# log fold change vs mean
logX=np.log2(Xp)
mean_other = np.log2((Xp.sum(axis=1).values[:,None]-Xp.values)/(7)+0.1)
lf=logX.values-mean_other
# top by mean expression too
for j in range(8):
    scores=lf[:,j]*np.log1p(X.values[:,j]) # product
    idx=np.argsort(-scores)[:30]
    print('\\nCOL',j)
    for i in idx:
        print(genes[i], 'expr',X.values[i,j], 'lf',lf[i,j], 'score',scores[i])

import gzip, json, time, requests, sys
genes=[]
with gzip.open('multiome.match.atac.rna.q1.rna.tsv.gz','rt') as f:
    next(f)
    for line in f:
        genes.append(line.split('\\t',1)[0])
print(len(genes), genes[:10])
pos={}
batch=500
sess=requests.Session()
for st in range(0,len(genes),batch):
    q=genes[st:st+batch]
    for attempt in range(3):
        try:
            r=sess.post('https://mygene.info/v3/query', json={'q':q,'scopes':'symbol','fields':'symbol,genomic_pos','species':'human','size':batch}, timeout=60)
            r.raise_for_status()
            hits=r.json()
            break
        except Exception as e:
            print('retry',st,attempt,e)
            time.sleep(2)
    else:
        continue
    for h in hits:
        # h is dict; may be notfound with notfound True
        qry=h.get('query')
        sym=h.get('symbol')
        gp=h.get('genomic_pos')
        if not qry: continue
        # Prefer exact symbol? store first hit with gp, but later hits may include same.
        if gp and qry not in pos:
            pos[qry]=(sym,gp)
        elif gp and qry in pos and sym==qry and not pos[qry][1]:
            pos[qry]=(sym,gp)
    if st%5000==0:
        print('done',st,'found',len(pos), 'sample', list(pos.items())[-1:] if pos else None)
    time.sleep(0.1)
print('total found',len(pos))
missing=[g for g in genes if g not in pos]
print('missing',len(missing),missing[:20])
# save
with open('gene_positions.json','w') as f:
    json.dump({k:v for k,v in pos.items()},f)
PY"

f='Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.116.gtf.gz'
pos={}
t0=time.time()
with gzip.open(f,'rt') as fh:
    for line in fh:
        if line.startswith('#'): continue
        parts=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        if len(parts)<9: continue
        if parts[2]"'!='"'gene': continue
        chrom=parts[0]
        # accept chr? GTF has 1.. no chr; RNA/ATAC use chr. store without? add chr later
        start=int(parts[3]); end=int(parts[4]); strand=parts[6]
        attr=parts[8]
        d={}
        for kv in attr.split(';'):
            kv=kv.strip()
            if not kv: continue
            if ' ' in kv:
                k,v=kv.split(' ',1)
            else:
                k=kv; v=''
            v=v.strip().strip('\"')
            d[k]=v
        gid=d.get('gene_id','')
        gname=d.get('gene_name',gid)
        # store all? gene_name collisions (unique mostly)
        if gname and gname not in pos:
            pos[gname]={'chr':'chr'+chrom if not chrom.startswith('chr') else chrom,'start':start,'end':end,'strand':strand,'gene_id':gid}
        elif gname in pos:
            # merge min/max if multiple genes same name? choose first or merge
            old=pos[gname]
            old['start']=min(old['start'],start); old['end']=max(old['end'],end)
    print('parsed',len(pos),'time',time.time()-t0)
